name.value: The ‘Grizzly’ slippers are the most popular amongst the wide product range of German manufacturer Haflinger. Their uppers are made of 100% natural wool felt without any artificial fibers. The absence of synthetics in combination with 60 years of experience in traditional handcrafting is why these slippers are warm, robust & breathable at the same time. Typical for a ‘Grizzly’ is the thick, anatomical footbed made of natural cork and latex. It further and further adapts to your feet during the course of wearing, resulting in perfectly cushioned steps. On top of that, your feet muscles are actively supported. Therefore, the model can be worn for hours without losing any of its comfortable feeling. The outer sole is made of firm rubber and has a slip-inhibitory profile. It is very solid and fully suitable outdoors as well.
